question: Due to the service done by the poet ___________, the Kathakali dance form received a new impetus and today, many innovations are also being made to suit the needs of a changing society.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vallathol Narayan Menon.**__

• **Vallathol Narayana Menon was a poet in the Malayalam language.**
 
• He was one of the triumvirate poets of modern Malayalam, along with Kumaran Asan and Ulloor S. Parameswara Iyer.
